items.title: California bans addictive social feeds for under-16s
items.summary: Newsom signed AB 1709 barring infinite scroll and autoplay for under-16s, plus chatbot toy and companion AI safeguards.

items.title: France resubmits under-15 social media ban to the EU
items.summary: Macron’s government notified the European Commission of a reworked ban after courts struck down the earlier law.

items.title: California’s Adam’s Law tightens AI chatbot rules for kids
items.summary: New law requires parental controls, crisis alerts, and safety audits for companion chatbots used by minors.
